newsitem.title: USA: U.S Michigan consumer sentiment preliminary March 101.9.
newsitem.headline: U.S Michigan consumer sentiment preliminary March 101.9.

text.p: The University of Michigan's preliminary index of consumer sentiment for March rose to 101.9 compared to 99.7 in the final February index, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component rose to 112.4 in the preliminary March report against the 107.2 reading in the final February.
The expectations index rose to 95.2 in the March preliminary data versus 94.9 in the final February, the sources added.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
